name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Business, Investment, or Property Ownership

requirements.blocker_text: Investment of at least AZN 500,000 in the Azerbaijani economy (entrepreneurs and adequately capitalized business owners), evidenced by tax registry extracts and turnover statements. Heads of branches/representations of foreign companies also qualify.
requirements.fix_path: Invest at least AZN 500,000 in a qualifying Azerbaijani business.

requirements.blocker_text: Ownership of real estate in Azerbaijan worth at least AZN 100,000, evidenced by a property registry extract and a professional valuation.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate worth at least AZN 100,000.

requirements.blocker_text: A bank deposit or securities holding worth at least AZN 100,000.
requirements.fix_path: Place at least AZN 100,000 in a qualifying bank deposit or securities.

evidence_required.document: Tax registry extracts and turnover statements (business route)
Property registry extract and professional valuation (real estate route)

sources.title: Azerbaijan State Migration Service -- grounds for temporary residence permit via business investment (AZN 500,000), real estate ownership (AZN 100,000), and bank deposits/securities (AZN 100,000)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Azerbaijan). These three thresholds are all directly tier-1 quoted from the State Migration Service. Note the higher thresholds required for PERMANENT (not temporary) residence via the same grounds -- AZN 200,000 for property/deposits/securities after 2 years -- modeled in az_permanent_residence.json rather than here, since that is a genuinely separate stage with its own figures, not a restatement of this file's temporary-permit thresholds.
